prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Verbatim text to speak. Put delivery directions in style_instructions; inline vocal events may use <laugh> or <sigh>. The provider limits the complete input to 8,192 tokens.

style_instructions.title: Style Instructions
style_instructions.description: Delivery style, separate from the spoken transcript.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS

Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS: the lower-cost Gemini voice model, with the same 30 prebuilt voices and natural-language style direction.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string, required | — | Text to speak. |
| `style_instructions` | string | — | How to say it, e.g. “calm newsreader”. |
| `voice` | `Achernar` / `Achird` / `Algenib` / `Algieba` / `Alnilam` / `Aoede` / `Autonoe` / `Callirrhoe` / `Charon` / `Despina` / `Enceladus` / `Erinome` / `Fenrir` / `Gacrux` / `Iapetus` / `Kore` / `Laomedeia` / `Leda` / `Orus` / `Pulcherrima` / `Puck` / `Rasalgethi` / `Sadachbia` / `Sadaltager` / `Schedar` / `Sulafat` / `Umbriel` / `Vindemiatrix` / `Zephyr` / `Zubenelgenubi` | `Kore` | Prebuilt voice. |

## Billing

$0.03 per started 1,000 characters of text, with a one-unit minimum.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 200 characters | $0.03 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.03 |
| 2,500 characters | $0.09 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Keep style direction short and concrete.

## Limits

- Single speaker per request.

## Also on SandBase

Related: `google/gemini-3.8-flash-tts` (higher quality), `google/gemini-3.1-flash-tts` (multi-speaker).
